title: The wq Programming Language
description: A runnable introduction to the core wq language.

chapters.title: Start Here
chapters.description: Run your first expression and learn how the book, results, and reference fit together.

chapters.title: Values and Display
chapters.description: Recognize atoms, containers, bools, chars, strings, tags, and displayed results.

chapters.title: Arithmetic
chapters.description: Use calculator expressions, exact arithmetic, broadcasting, and comparisons.

chapters.title: Binding
chapters.description: Name values, update bindings, and unpack shapes.

chapters.title: Calls, Indexing, and Postfix
chapters.description: Apply functions and containers without falling into postfix precedence traps.

chapters.title: Lists
chapters.description: Create, index, slice, and deliberately mutate ordered containers.

chapters.title: Functions
chapters.description: Package transformations, name parameters, and capture nearby bindings.

chapters.title: Dicts
chapters.description: Use ordered tag-keyed containers and named arguments.

chapters.title: Pipes
chapters.description: Move values left to right through transformations and checkpoints.

chapters.title: Control Flow
chapters.description: Choose branches, repeat work, and return early with bool conditions.

chapters.title: Errors
chapters.description: Read diagnostics, raise errors, assert outcomes, and inspect failures with `@t`.

chapters.title: Modules
chapters.description: Export one value from an isolated file and import it through a cached module workspace.

chapters.title: A Prime Sieve
chapters.description: Combine lists, mutation, pipes, control flow, and functions in one complete program.

chapters.title: Symbolic Math with CAS
chapters.description: Optional: quote symbolic expressions, transform them, and cross into numeric evaluation.
